name: Proposal Engagement
summary: Scores proposal owners by proposal results and community ratings in the Deep Funding Portal.
description:
### What it does
Scores proposal owners by proposal results and community ratings in the Deep Funding Portal.

### How it works
- Reputo identifies each user by their decentralized identifier (DID).
- Funded and completed proposals add points.
- Unfunded proposals remove points.
- Higher ratings increase rewards and reduce penalties.
- Older proposals can lose value over time.

### Limits
Only rounds 31, 36, and 107 are included because they have reliable ownership data.

### Data used
Proposal, user, and review data from the Deep Funding Portal.

### Results
- A CSV file with `did` and `proposal_engagement`.
- A JSON file with score details for each user and proposal.

inputs.label: Funded proposal reward
inputs.description: How much a funded and completed proposal increases the score. Use `0` to turn off this reward.

inputs.label: Unfunded proposal penalty
inputs.description: How much an unfunded proposal reduces the score. Use `0` to turn off this penalty.

inputs.label: Time period (months)
inputs.description: Number of previous months of proposals to include. A short period may exclude all supported rounds and give every user a score of `0`.

inputs.label: Monthly score reduction (%)
inputs.description: Percentage removed from a proposal's score for each month of age. Use `0` to keep older scores unchanged.

outputs.label: Proposal engagement (CSV)
outputs.description: One row per user with their final proposal engagement score.

columns.description: Final user score. It is not adjusted to a fixed range and can be negative when penalties are higher than rewards.

outputs.label: Proposal engagement details (JSON)
outputs.description: Score details and skip reasons for each user and proposal.
